يلتزموا (form VIII)
# يَلْتَزِمُوا (yaltazimū) /jal.ta.zi.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
# يُلْتَزَمُوا (yultazamū) /jul.ta.za.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
